The first step is to create the brief. Once you click the “Create Article” button, the following popup will appear.

![create a brief seowind](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/WTSW1-1024x553.png)

In order to create a brief, you need to enter:

- one keyword you would like to create content for,
- choose Location (and if the selected country is the United States, you can also select a State),
- select Language,
- choose a Project (If you’re creating your first brief, you’ll need to create a Project first)

Selecting the state gives you more localized data and ensures your content is better tailored to regional search intent.

If you have your Google Search Console (GSC) integrated for this project, the system will also check if you’re already ranking for the chosen keyword to help you avoid keyword cannibalization. In addition, you’ll be able to get keyword suggestions by clicking on the ???? under the **Focus keyword** field.

Once you’re ready click “Create brief”. Now the system will analyze the data for a particular keyword. We are going through tons of data and steps:

- Analyzing Top SERPs
- Extracting Keywords
- Filtering Relevant Keywords
- Analyzing Questions to Answer
- NLP analysis of gathered data

Once the data is analyzed, on the dashboard next to your brief, you will see the “Open” action.

**Pro tips:**

- Please be patient, take a break for 1-2 minutes when the system is gathering data, or add a second brief while you’re waiting for the first one to be created.
- Once you select location and language it will be your default setting for your next brief.
- Currently, you can create content briefs in over 180 locations around the globe in the following languages:
  - English
  - Czech
  - Dutch
  - French
  - German
  - Indonesian
  - Italian
  - Polish
  - Portuguese
  - Slovak
  - Spanish
  - Swedish
